title: Ten Sessions
cn: 第 13 集 · 十次疗程
novel:
Ted met [[dermatologist|dermatologist]] Stella for tattoo [[removal|removal]]. Ten [[sessions|session]] became ten chances to [[win over|win over]] her with [[persistence|persistence]].

"I don't date [[patients|patient]]," Stella [[declared|declare]]. But Ted [[refused|refuse]] to give up. Each [[session|session]], he brought a new [[argument|argument]], a new [[joke|joke]], a new reason she should [[say yes|say yes]].

"You're [[persistent|persistent]]," Stella [[admitted|admit]] after the fifth session. "I'll give you that."

Barney [[bet|bet]] Ted would fail. Robin [[sided|side]] with Stella. Lily [[rooted|root]] for Ted.

By the eighth session, Stella [[canceled|cancel]] an [[appointment|appointment]]. Ted [[panicked|panic]]. Was she avoiding him?

At the tenth session, the tattoo was gone. Ted [[looked|look]] at Stella. "One more chance?" he asked. She smiled. "Dinner. One dinner." [[Persistence|persistence]], Ted realized, sometimes paid off.

win over.en: to persuade someone to like you

argument.en: a reason to support a view

bet.en: to risk money on an outcome
